# Choosing a Pond

*Test fixture. This text is invented for automated tests and comes from no published book.*

The pond decides more than the boat does.

## Three ponds compared

| Pond | Depth | Wind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Garden basin | Two spans | Still |
| Mill pond | Nine spans | Gusty |
| Rain barrel | One span | None |

## A launch checklist

Read the checklist aloud before each launch.

```text
check hull dry
check wind below gusty
launch from the lee bank
```
